description: This file defines the ViewMyClaimController class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a 'my-claim' component in the preRender method.

classes.name: ViewMyClaimController
classes.description: Controller handling the display of the user's claim view, responsible for rendering the 'my-claim' component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the 'my-claim' Vue component before rendering the view.
